packageRules.description: storybook-addon-vis 4.3.1 and @repobuddy/vitest 2.x peer on vitest ^4, and this is a Storybook addon library; keep vitest and @vitest/* on v4 until those support v5.
The packageManager pin is toolchain, so non-major updates merge themselves.
The toolchain pins (mise, nvm) move with packageManager, so they merge themselves too.
Repo-internal updates merge themselves once code / all-checks is green.

These reach every consumer of @repobuddy/storybook and need a changeset, so a human decides. Scoped to the published manifest: the private root and apps/app list their tooling under `dependencies` too, and that tooling ships to nobody.
The private root and the demo app publish nothing, so their `dependencies` are tooling and automerge like devDependencies.
Majors break builds in ways CI catches but a human should choose to absorb.
